source: Create a huge outdoor music festival map inspired by LoudLand Party Roblox. Build a massive main stage with dynamic neon lights, moving LED screens, and laser systems. Add a large open dance floor in front of the stage with custom dance animations for players. Around the festival area, place food trucks, VVIP lounges, and neon decorations. Crucial: Add an interactive on-screen Music GUI (menu) where players can click buttons to change between different music channels (Pop, Rock, Hip-Hop, EDM, and Romanian Manele rhythms)."

image_prompt.text: A massive main stage as the hero focal build, composed to be framed from across the festival grounds
A large open dance floor directly in front of the stage where the crowd congregates rather than moves through
dynamic neon lights, moving LED screens, and laser systems on the main stage
food trucks placed around the festival area
VVIP lounges around the festival area
neon decorations scattered through the grounds

layout_placement.text: Spawn placed and oriented so the first thing a player sees on joining is the stage, never backstage geometry
Small optional finds tucked off the main circulation for players who explore the grounds

notes: Music and Audio normally routes P5, but this is a physical venue with a stage, a floor, and a crowd, so it builds.
The on-screen Music GUI the user called crucial is screen-space and has no layout representation at all.
The stage is carried as the hero focal build, but nothing in the genre expresses a stage as a performance structure with a performer area, wings, or front-of-house.

open_questions.ask: Is there anything to do besides hang out and dance - performer roles, timed sets, a queue for the stage?
How big is huge here - a few hundred people on one field, or a multi-stage grounds you walk between?

theme: Neon Music Festival - open-air, saturated neon, stage lighting and lasers against night

coverage_missing.ask: Is there anything to do besides hang out and dance - performer roles, timed sets, a queue for the stage?
How big is huge here - one field, or grounds you walk between?

answers.ask: Is there anything to do besides hang out and dance - performer roles, timed sets, a queue for the stage?
answers.answer: No—keep it focused on hanging out, dancing, exploring the festival amenities, and using the Music GUI to switch channels; no performer roles, timed sets, or stage queue are needed.

answers.ask: How big is huge here - a few hundred people on one field, or a multi-stage grounds you walk between?
answers.answer: Use one large festival field centered on the massive main stage and dance floor, with the food trucks and VVIP lounges around its perimeter rather than separate walk-between stages.
